finalMessage:
Implemented shipping in the quote and charged total: free at a discounted subtotal of 100.00 or more, otherwise 5.99.

All 37 tests pass. OSTF check against `main` passes with 113 valid links.

Trace impact: `R-SHIPPING`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-TAX-RATE`. Added draft `R-SHIPPING`, linked to `price` and the new checkout shipping test.

Impact tests passed: `Checkout` and `price` suites, including “charges shipping based on the discounted subtotal”, “places an order”, “taxes the subtotal after discounts”, plus `tax > rounds half up to the cent`.
